context: It's Hiroshi (elder)'s 71st birthday. Yumiko (his neighbor for years) has stopped by with a small cake.
purpose: neighborhood-affection — small birthday between people who have known each other a long time

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ひろし先生、ちょっと、いいですか？
lines.en: Hiroshi-sensei — do you have a moment?
lines.style: Soft knock at the door. Respectful hesitation. Warm but measured, the voice of someone used to respecting boundaries.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ、ゆみこさん。どうしました？
lines.en: Ah — Yumiko-san. What brings you by?
lines.style: Genuine pleasure beneath the formality. A slight opening up. The tone of someone pleased to see someone they respect.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お誕生日、お祝いです。本当に、ささやかですが。
lines.en: Happy birthday. It's very modest, I'm afraid, but…
lines.style: Gentle ceremonial quality. A small bow lives in the breath. Hands forward with the gift, voice steady but tender.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: …(quiet beat)よく覚えていてくださって。
lines.style: A catch in the voice — surprise underneath composure. The word catches slightly, the professor-voice threatens to soften. A moment of real feeling breaking through.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 当たり前です。…お元気で、何よりです。
lines.en: Of course. …I'm just glad you're well — that matters most.
lines.style: Soft and genuine. The second part carries weight without effort. No performance, just honest feeling underneath the politeness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: Thank you. Truly — this means a great deal.
lines.style: Small, deliberate bow in the voice. Steady but moved. A man composing himself with gratitude.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お時間ある時、お茶でも、いつでも。
lines.en: Please — whenever you have time, come have tea with me. Anytime.
lines.style: An invitation that mirrors the one received. Gentle reciprocity. The door opens a little wider in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ぜひ。…今日は、本当にいい一日になりました。
lines.en: I would like that. …You know, today has become quite a special day.
lines.style: Closing line with quiet finality. Steps back from the doorway slowly. The voice settling into peaceful satisfaction.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: A small smile audible in the words. The voice already turning toward the hallway. Warm departure, no lingering.
